استبرئا (form X)
# اُسْتُبْرِئَا (ustubriʔā) /us.tub.ri.ʔaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَبْرَأَ (istabraʔa)
# اِسْتَبْرِئَا (istabriʔā) /is.tab.ri.ʔaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَبْرَأَ (istabraʔa)
